rationale: C103 flags negative fair_value rows. The raw SOI shows the same negative fair values as parenthesized amounts in the Fair Value column for revolver positions, including G&A Partners at (35) thousand and R.F. Fager at (19) thousand. Because the source itself reports these negative fair values, the extracted negative values are not data errors; the flag is a legitimate-review rule firing on source-correct negative fair values.
